newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa trucking strike ballot results next week.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa trucking strike ballot results next week.

text.p: South Africa's Transport and General Workers' Union said on Friday that regional and national results of a ballot on industrial action by truck drivers would be known by the end of next week.
But national organiser Thulani Dlamini said early results showed overwhelming support for a strike against members of the Road Freight Employers' Association.
If the union's 36,000 members decide to strike in the week beginning November 18, virtually all sectors of the economy would be affected.
Talks on wage increases for next year reached deadlock in September with workers demanding an across-the-board increases of between 15 and 20 percent. Employers have offered nine percent.
Dlamini said industrial action, which could combine strikes, overtime bans and work to rule, would start in the week beginning November 18.
